formulas.description: Formula that evaluates the conditions in order and returns the appropriate error message: - Fault message - No Sales Territory was found
formulas.name: ErrorMessage
formulas.expression: LEFT( IF( NOT(ISBLANK({!$Flow.FaultMessage})), {!$Flow.FaultMessage}, IF( NOT({!YES_Marketing_Products}), "Marketing Product not found", IF( OR(NOT({!Assignment_Successfully_Territory_Match}),NOT({!Assignment_Successfully_Territory_Match_Triggering})), "No territory match found for: Account=" & {!Get_Account.Id} & ", Industry=" & TEXT({!Get_Account.Industry}) & ", State=" & {!Get_Account.BillingState} & ", Marketing Products=" & {!MarketingProductwithNoTerritoryMatchTextCollection}, null ) ) ), 255)
